section_summary.extract_value: This section reports factor analysis results for a female sample's BAS items: Bartlett's test (χ2(78)=2596.48, p < .001) and KMO = .90 indicated adequacy for factor analysis; parallel analysis suggested retaining two factors. The first factor resembled a General Body Appreciation factor (explaining 51.2% of variance; α = .93) and the second reflected an adaptive Body Image Investment component (14.2% variance; α = .72); the two factors correlated r = .37. No sample size, demographic (age, race), BMI, survey method, or country information is provided in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: For the female sample, Bartlett's test of sphericity, 2(78) = 2596.48, p < .001, and the KMO measure of sampling adequacy, KMO = .90, showed that the BAS items had adequate common variance for factor analysis. The first factor ... explaining 51.2% of the variance; α= .93. The second factor ... explaining 14.2% of the variance; α= .72. The two factors were moderately correlated (r = .37).
